## Summary

What would you like to add or improve?

## Who Is This For?

Examples: brokerage owner, office admin, listing coordinator, agent support team, developer, contributor.

## Workflow Problem

What real brokerage operations problem does this solve?

## Proposed Solution

Describe the desired behavior or outcome.

## Alternatives Considered

What alternatives or workarounds exist today?

## Scope Notes

Does this affect business logic, database schema, permissions, extension behavior, docs, or UI only?

## Additional Context

Add sketches, examples, or links if useful. Do not include private deployment details or sensitive data.
